howItWorks.title: How Precision 3D Printing Works
howItWorks.description: From raw CAD geometry to physically tested functional hardware in 3 simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select an engineered model from our catalog, or upload your own 3D file in STL, 3MF, STEP, or OBJ format.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Pick your polymer (PETG-CF, Tough PLA, ABS, Resin), select infill density, and checkout securely via COD, InstaPay, or Vodafone Cash.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our automated print farm slices, prints, and anneals your part. Receive WhatsApp photo updates and express doorstep delivery.
howItWorks.whatsappAlertDesc: We notify you on WhatsApp when slicing starts, when the print bed finishes, and when your package ships.

whyUs.title: Why Hardware Engineers Choose Print Studio
whyUs.description: We don't just print models — we engineer additive solutions with strict mechanical tolerances and production reliability.
whyUs.pillar1Desc: High-temp direct-drive extruders, enclosed heated chambers, and calibrated print profiles prevent warping and structural weak spots.
whyUs.pillar2Desc: Active vibration compensation (input shaping) and multi-point bed mesh leveling ensure tight mechanical tolerances for snap-fit assemblies.
whyUs.pillar3Desc: Choose from lightweight decorative PLA+ to carbon fiber-infused PETG, heat-resistant ABS, flexible TPU 95A, and 8K SLA precision resin.
whyUs.pillar4Desc: Talk directly with hardware and slicing engineers over WhatsApp. Get immediate advice on model orientation, wall count, and material selection.

finalCta.titleLine1: Ready to Bring Your Digital CAD
finalCta.description: Whether you need a single precision prototype, high-durability mechanical replacement parts, or an on-demand production run, our studio print farm is standing by.

footer.val1Desc: Industrial Bambu X1C & Voron print farm running 24/7 for zero downtime.
footer.val2Desc: Calibrated to ±0.1mm tolerances for flawless mechanical fitment.
footer.val3Desc: PETG-Carbon Fiber, Tough PLA+, High-Temp ABS, and 8K High-Resin.
footer.val4Desc: Direct engineering support for slicing orientation and infill advice.
footer.about: Next-generation 3D printing studio based in Cairo, Egypt. From rapid engineering prototypes to customized on-demand production batches.
footer.newsletterDesc: Receive alerts on limited engineering material drops, test models, and maker discounts.
